adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the service now performs a token refresh unconditionally during construction/initialization: it immediately `fetch`es `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` using the stored `refresh_token`, throws on any non-"OK" `statusText`, and only then creates the `jsforce.Connection` (which could otherwise use the existing `credential.key` access token). There is no gating by token expiry or `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED`, and no fallback/tolerance; thus transient refresh failures can prevent the connection from being created and block Salesforce operations even when the previously stored access token might still be valid.
